review_note: Reviewed by reading tests/testthat/test-binomial-labelled-q2-sd-b32.R and the helpers it uses. (1) The oracle is independent: sb26_laplace in helper-sb26-oracle.R is base-R dense Laplace and calls no drmTMB code. The kernels are hand-built, namely a Henderson tabular A from an inbred pedigree (max diag >1.6) and cov2cor(ape::vcv(tree)). The oracle uses the fitted rho, with kernel rows reversed against the level order, and the phylo tip helper is compared against the hand kernel. Agreement is required at 1e-4 on logLik. (2) Sensitivity is asserted at >0.1 for nine bugs: swapped selector coefficients, reversed SD intercept and slope, swapped intercept/slope SD, K read by position, K times 2, rho 0, rho flipped, and cov2cor(K) or raw vcv. The test also checks that the fitted |rho| exceeds 0.3, so those bugs are real changes. The simulation test adds variance-ratio bands that rho 0, a flipped rho and the cov2cor diagonal each leave by more than 0.10. (3) The linked rows are fitted. animal/A_covariance is fitted for logit, probit and cloglog (mu:I and mu:x1), and phylo/tree for logit, all with the labelled block and both SD formulas. The Ainv_precision and pedigree rows are fitted for logit only, on seed 32431. Those two routes rest on logLik equality with the A fit at 1e-6 and rho equality at 1e-4, so they are oracle-backed only through the A fit, which has the oracle on that same seed and link. They have no oracle of their own. (4) I recomputed all manifest sha256 values, including R/binomial-q2-sd.R and the four helpers, and they match the current files. The receipt, manifest and console-log hashes match as well. The console log shows passed=166 failed=0 errors=0 skipped=0, EXIT=0, and the test did not skip on the ape check. The Julia line (0 live tests) is expected for a native-only claim. DOES NOT ESTABLISH: coverage, calibration, recovery or estimator accuracy (likelihood evaluation at fixed seeds, one seed per link); Julia parity; direct independent-oracle validation of Ainv and pedigree inputs (equality with the A fit, logit only); probit or cloglog for Ainv, pedigree or phylo (phylo probit and cloglog are refused by design); Binomial relmat, spatial or iid labelled q2 (relmat and spatial are refused); and labelled blocks without SD formulas. The rho-moves check shows the estimate follows the sign of the data (phylo +0.703 vs -0.837), not that it is unbiased.
